mentions.name: Datagrok
mentions.description: This platform lets users efficiently work with any data right in the browser, supporting interactive visualization of millions of rows and augmentation of data with domain-specific capabilities, such as a cheminformatics plugin that automatically recognizes molecules and provides rendering and substructure search.
mentions.audience: People working with data, particularly scientific data
mentions.source_excerpt: A platform to efficiently work with any data right in the browser. Like interactively visualizing millions or rows, and at the same time augmenting the data with domain-specific capabilities. For instance, the cheminformatics plugin automatically recognizes molecules and provides proper rendering, substructure search etc. Sort of a Swiss Army knife for scientific data.
